verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe retrieved an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.0.3 document at /openapi/mesh-api.json covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional paths (openapi.json, .well-known) only show the spec lives at a non-standard location; they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: discoverability at a conventional or well-known spec path, and confirmation that the spec covers the full API surface (e.g., webhooks, screening, IAM).
